Name: Zimri, Son of Salu
Summary: Zimri, son of Salu, was a prince of Simeon who openly brought the Midianite woman Cozbi into the camp at Peor.
KeyStory: Zimri's open defiance was stopped by Phinehas, whose zeal turned away God's wrath from Israel.
LifeLesson: Sin flaunted in the open is still sin — and it still costs.
